_meta.rationale: Stripe's display face Sohne maps to Inter in BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY. Primary display element on the alphabet template is h1.a-display-1. The :root override forces --ds-font-display to Inter. Negative assertion scans for slug=stripe strip targets plus universal forbidden patterns.
gaps: Stripe's signature indigo (#635BFF) lives only in the category_fidelity_spec.md fixture bag; no production registry pins it per-brand for the alphabet category, so an --ds-accent computed_css assertion is deferred.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('h1.a-display-1'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['stripe.com/img/v3/home/twitter.png', 'stripe-logo', 'stripe-wordmark', '/img/stripe', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-body'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
